style.styleTitle: Personalised Woodland Berries Light Up Christmas Wreath by Dibor
style.toneOfVoice: Brighten up your home this winter with our beautiful pre-lit Christmas wreath. A rustic arrangement of natural wood is carefully crafted to showcase stunning quality and attention to detail, with impressively sized woodland foraged pinecones, lovingly painted for a snow-dusted effect. Bushels of red berries and shimmering baubles add a festive pop of colour which stands out against the neutral tones, for a subtle and stylish Christmas decoration. The indoor wreath is complete witha twinkle of LED lights that will give your home a warm and cosy glow all through the festive season. Each wreath is complete with a natural wood tag engraved with your chosen bespoke message. Battery operated. Batteries sold seperately. Indoor use only. Diameter 30cm.
